image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a sliced fig. The image displays the cross-section of the fruit, revealing the internal pinkish-amber pulp and numerous tiny seeds. The outer skin is visible at the top edge, appearing greenish-brown with a short stem attached. The texture of the flesh appears moist and fibrous.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pear-shaped fruit with soft, thin skin in green, purple, or brownish coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the skin at the top exhibits the characteristic greenish-brown hue and thin appearance consistent with a fig.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth to slightly wrinkled texture with matte finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture appears natural, neither overly glossy nor artificially smooth, matching the matte/waxy finish of real figs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated pear shape with tapered form from broad base to narrow stem end.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight crop of a cross-section; the full external silhouette and tapering shape are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small ostiole (eye) at bottom of fruit.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bottom of the fruit (where the ostiole is located) is outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Narrow stem end contrasting with broad rounded base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The broad base is not visible due to cropping; only the stem end is partially visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin, easily bruised skin covering soft interior.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The boundary between the skin and the flesh is distinct, showing a thin layer consistent with fig anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals hollow interior filled with numerous tiny seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the internal structure packed with small, distinct seeds embedded in the matrix.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Sweet, pink to amber-colored fleshy pulp surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration of the pulp ranges from deep pink/red near the skin to amber/yellow in the center, matching the description perfectly.
The visual texture of the pulp appears moist, soft, and cohesive, consistent with ripe fig flesh.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific botanical identity of the fruit and rule out look-alikes like pomegranates or prickly pears based on internal seed structure.
To analyze the micro-texture of the seeds and pulp for signs of AI 'smearing' or repetitive pattern artifacts common in generated organic interiors.
To ensure the transition between the skin and the internal flesh is physically coherent and not blurred or fused incorrectly.

focus_areas: Seed distribution randomness and individual definition
Color gradient consistency from skin to core
Absence of melting artifacts in the moist pulp
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the seed structures. In AI-generated images, seeds often merge into the background pulp or exhibit identical shapes/sizes. Verify if the seeds have natural variance. Also, check the stem attachment point for any structural impossibilities or blending errors with the fruit body.
